description_sq:
Shitet apartament 3+1 tek Square 21, Rruga e Kavajes.
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje rezidence te kerkuar dhe teper e preferuar per banim.
Planimetri e rregullt dhe e shfrytezueshme.
Organizohet ne korridor qe ben shperndarjen ne : soxhorno bashke me kuzhinen, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkon.
Disponon kontrate porosie.
description_en: 3+1 apartment for sale at Square 21, Rruga e Kavaje. The apartment is part of a sought-after and highly preferred residence. Neat and usable floor plan. It is organized in a corridor that divides it into: living room with kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. Order contracts are available.
